```{r}
#| label: packages
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(flexdashboard)
library(plotly)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(sf)
library(countrycode)

data_path <- "../../../Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-pezeshka@gmail.com/My Drive/R/interests_github/data/"
```

## 
```{r}
#| label: read in data ucdp prio armed conflict dataset
#| warning: false
df_prio <- read_csv(file = paste0(data_path, "armed_conflict_yearly.csv"))
df_bd <- read_csv(file = paste0(data_path, "battle_deaths_dyad.csv"))
```

```{r}
# 1. Global trends data
conflict_trends <- df_prio %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(n_conflicts = n())

death_trends <- df_bd %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(total_deaths = sum(bd_best))

# 2. Conflict type and intensity data
conflict_types <- df_prio %>%
  group_by(year, type_of_conflict) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(type_of_conflict = case_when(
    type_of_conflict == 1 ~ "Extrasystemic",
    type_of_conflict == 2 ~ "Interstate",
    type_of_conflict == 3 ~ "Intrastate",
    type_of_conflict == 4 ~ "Internationalized Intrastate"
  ))

conflict_intensity <- df_prio %>%
  group_by(year, intensity_level) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(intensity_level = if_else(intensity_level == 1, "Minor", "War"))

# 3. Geographical data
# 1. Get world map data from rnaturalearth. It already has the 'iso_a3' code.
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# 2. In the UCDP deaths data, create a new column with the standard ISO A3 code.
# The countrycode() function is smart about converting different name variations.
deaths_by_iso <- df_bd %>%
  # Approximate country by taking the first name listed in side_a_new
  mutate(country_name = str_split(side_a, ", ") %>% map_chr(1)), 
         iso_a3 = countrycode(country_name, origin = 'country.name', destination = 'iso_a3')) %>%
  # Remove rows where a country code couldn't be found
  filter(!is.na(iso_a3)) %>%
  group_by(iso_a3) %>%
  summarise(total_deaths = sum(bd_best))

# 3. Join the map data and the death data using the reliable ISO A3 code.
# A right_join ensures we keep all countries from the map.
map_data <- right_join(world, deaths_by_iso, by = "iso_a3")

# Join with death data to get total deaths per conflict location
deaths_by_country <- df_bd %>%
  mutate(country = side_a) %>% # Approximate location with side_a
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  summarise(total_deaths = sum(bd_best))

# Join for mapping
map_data <- deaths_by_country %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(total_deaths = sum(total_deaths)) %>%
  right_join(world, by = c("country" = "name"))

# Regional data
regional_deaths <- df_bd %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(total_deaths = sum(bd_best))

regional_conflicts <- df_prio %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(n_conflicts = n())
```

```{r}
# --- Plot 1: Number of Active Conflicts ---
plot_ly(conflict_trends, x = ~year, y = ~n_conflicts, type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines') %>%
  layout(title = "Number of Active Armed Conflicts per Year",
         xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Number of Conflicts"))

# --- Plot 2: Total Battle-Related Deaths ---
plot_ly(death_trends, x = ~year, y = ~total_deaths, type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines', fill = 'tozeroy', fillcolor = 'rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.3)') %>%
  layout(title = "Total Battle-Related Deaths per Year",
         xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Total Deaths"))

# --- Plot 3: Conflicts by Type ---
plot_ly(conflict_types, x = ~year, y = ~count, color = ~type_of_conflict, type = 'bar') %>%
  layout(barmode = 'stack',
         title = "Conflicts by Type over Time",
         xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Number of Conflicts"))

# --- Plot 4: Conflicts by Intensity ---
plot_ly(conflict_intensity, x = ~year, y = ~count, color = ~intensity_level, type = 'bar', colors = c("orange", "red")) %>%
  layout(barmode = 'stack',
         title = "Conflicts by Intensity over Time",
         xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Number of Conflicts"))

# --- Plot 5: World Map of Conflict Deaths ---
plot_ly(
  data = map_data,
  type = 'choropleth',
  locations = ~iso_a3,
  z = ~total_deaths,
  text = ~paste(country, "<br>Total Deaths:", total_deaths),
  colorscale = "Reds",
  marker = list(line = list(width = 0.5, color = toRGB("grey")))
) %>%
  colorbar(title = "Total Deaths") %>%
  layout(
    title = "Total Battle-Related Deaths by Country (1989-2023)",
    geo = list(
      showframe = FALSE,
      showcoastlines = FALSE,
      projection = list(type = 'mercator')
    )
  )
```

## Number of Armed Conflict by Conflict Type
Using the UCDP PRIO Armed Conflict Dataset, the below plot shows the number of armed conflicts over time. 
```{r}
data_clean <- df_bd %>%
  rename(
    deaths = bd_best,
    conflict_type_num = type_of_conflict
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    conflict_type = factor(case_when(
      conflict_type_num == 1 ~ "Extrasystemic",
      conflict_type_num == 2 ~ "Interstate",
      conflict_type_num == 3 ~ "Intrastate",
      conflict_type_num == 4 ~ "Internationalized Intrastate",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )),
    map_label = paste(
        "<strong>", side_a, "</strong><br>",
        "Country: ", battle_location, "<br>",
        "Year: ", year, "<br>",
        "Deaths (est.): ", format(deaths, big.mark = ",")
    )
  )

# --- Create a Crosstalk SharedData object ---
# This is the key to linking widgets and plots without a server
sd <- SharedData$new(data_clean, key = ~conflict_id, group = "conflicts")

filter_slider("year", "Year Range", sd, ~year, sep = "")

filter_select("region", "Region", sd, ~region, multiple = TRUE)
```
:::: {.layout-ncol=3}

```{r}
# KPI for Active Conflicts
plot_ly(sd, type = "indicator", mode = "number",
        value = ~n_distinct(conflict_id),
        title = list(text = "Active Conflicts")) %>%
  layout(height = 150)

```

```{r}
# KPI for Total Battle Deaths
plot_ly(sd, type = "indicator", mode = "number",
        value = ~sum(deaths),
        number = list(valueformat = ","), # Format with commas
        title = list(text = "Total Battle Deaths")) %>%
  layout(height = 150)
```


```{r}
# KPI for Countries Affected
plot_ly(sd, type = "indicator", mode = "number",
        value = ~n_distinct(battle_location),
        title = list(text = "Countries Affected")) %>%
  layout(height = 150)
```
:::: {.layout-ncol=2}

```{r}

#| title: "Geographic Distribution of Conflicts"

# The leaflet map is linked to the SharedData object 'sd'
leaflet(sd) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    radius = ~sqrt(deaths / 100) + 2, # Scale points by intensity
    color = "#E4572E",
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.6,
    popup = ~map_label
  )
```

```{r}
#| title: "Conflicts by Type"

# This plotly chart is also linked to the SharedData object
plot_ly(sd) %>%
  group_by(conflict_type) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  add_bars(
    x = ~count, 
    y = ~reorder(conflict_type, count), 
    orientation = 'h',
    marker = list(color = '#17BEBB')
    ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Number of Conflict Years"),
    yaxis = list(title = "")
  )
```

```{r}

#| title: "Conflict Trends Over Time"

plot_ly(sd, x = ~year) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(conflict_count = n_distinct(conflict_id), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  add_lines(
    y = ~conflict_count, 
    name = "Conflicts", 
    line = list(color = '#E4572E')
    ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of Active Conflicts")
  )
```
